<div class="card-body">
'''Breached Defenses''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] ([[Immediate Effect]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊基地への侵入</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">帝国軍がエコー基地の位置に移動した直後に使用する。場の自分の側に配備する。エコー基地の位置に自分の人員がいるなら、ホスの各位置での自分の側の合計戦闘力に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Breached-Defenses-PSA-151452823.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「帝国軍が基地内部に侵入！ 繰り返す。帝国軍が基地内部に……」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Invasion of the base.

'''Card text:'''
Use immediately after an Imperial moves to an Echo site. Deploy on your side of the table. If you have personnel at an Echo site, your total power is +1 in battles at Hoth sites.

'''Lore:'''
"Imperial troops have entered the base! Repeat. Imperial troops have entered the base…"

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese needs your personnel at an Echo site; the English needs presence.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Breached Defenses]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
